$comment: Marketing visual-asset manifest: every product screenshot/video on the site, bound to the product version it was captured against and to the exact bytes shipped (sha256). check-marketing-freshness.mjs flags per-asset staleness when the product's npm latest moves a minor/major beyond capturedAgainstVersion. check-marketing-assets.mjs (deploy-blocking, in npm run validate) verifies every asset's bytes match its sha256. Refreshing an asset = run the released product UI locally, capture via scripts/capture-marketing-screenshot.mjs --asset <path> --url <local url> --product-version <ver> (it refuses unstyled/broken renders and stamps this file), then human-review the visual before commit. Non-screenshot assets (GIFs) are produced externally and stamped via --stamp.
